title: Ping
description: Phone-to-Mac presence ping. POSTed as an envelope with type ping to /ping with an Authorization: Bearer <token> header. The phone advertises itself on every ping (heartbeat included); the Mac stores a local rename alias that overrides device_name for display only.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.1.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-ping value the pong must echo.

sent_at.description: Unix seconds when the ping was sent.

reply_port.description: Phone's listening port for the return ping. The Mac learns the return path (remote IP + this port) from accepted pings only and expires it after 60s silence.

device_name.description: Phone's self-reported display name (e.g. OnePlus 15R). Advertised on every ping; the Mac shows its local rename alias when one exists.

model.description: Phone hardware model (e.g. CPH2767). Advertised on every ping; never renamed.

battery_pct.description: Phone battery level percent. Volatile; carried on every heartbeat ping.

charging.description: True when the phone reports it is charging.
